svg.text: Figure 2.2 — The Six-Rung Epistemic Evidence Ladder
Ordering repository quantities from direct raw observations (bottom) to uncalibrated assumptions and unavailable values (top).
Rung 6 — Unavailable Channels, Unresolved Rules & Structural Assumptions (Epistemic Ceiling)
• Absent sensors: Heel, Pitch, Leeway, Foil Ride Height, Water Current, Polar Targets, Official Umpire Rulings, Independent Official Results (0/28).
• Uncalibrated assumptions: AC40→AC75 transfer loading ρ ∈ {0, 0.5, 1}; RRSAC 102.1 6-Challenger seeding tie (34.46% unresolved); 5-min wind projection (0/3,455 pass).
Rung 5 — Statistical, State-Space & External Reanalysis Model Estimates
• Forecasting: Constant-velocity Kalman state (x, y, vx, vy) during short gaps; Plackett–Luce skills θ_i (σ=1.2, κ=1.8); Correlated MC leg times; Beta-Binomial completion.
• Environment context: Open-Meteo hourly 2m air temp, wave height, SST (`environment-1`, grid model estimates, never used as causal pre-race weather).
Rung 4 — Geometric Reconstructions, Heuristic Detections & Peer-Relative Indexes (`reconstructed` / `performance-1`)
• Bow (+12.963 m) segment gate/start crossings; monotonic `progress_m`; reconstructed finish ranks & elapsed times; continuous progress time-gap estimate (Δp / v_leader).
• Manoeuvre detector tacks/gybes (ΔSOG ≥ 2.5 kt); SAT virtual contact overlaps (`virtual_contact_incidents`); matched-leg self-excluding peer indexes (100 = peer mean).
Rung 3 — Coverage-Gated Historical Metrics & Trailing Wind Summaries (`derived` / `partial` / `tactical-1`)
• Historical scalars (`historical-2`): leg-directed course VMG, wind VMG, sailed distance, route ratio, boundary exposure — gated at ≥95% valid source coverage & no gap > 2.0 s.
• Tactical wind (`tactical-1`): 120 s trailing window on raw official wind (≥60 samples, ≤2.0 s age, OLS slope in deg/min).
Rung 2 — Deterministic Coordinate Transforms & 100 ms Grid Resampling
• Local equirectangular curvature projection (WGS84 lat/lon → metres x, y via k_lat, k_lon, verified vs Haversine); speed conversion m/s × (3600/1852) → knots.
• 10 Hz replay grid: linear scalar/position interpolation & shortest-arc circular angle interpolation (with held endpoints before first / after last sample in replay).
Rung 1 — Direct Source Telemetry & Session Metadata (`measured` / `source_timing`)
• Raw JSONL records: ~20 Hz GNSS (latitude, longitude) & heading; ~4–5 Hz SOG, COG, boat TWD/TWS; ~1 Hz official wind asset TWD/TWS; mark GNSS tracks.
• Session boundaries, gun timestamp, sequence mark IDs, and competitor state snapshots (source leg timings, penalties, start_state flags).
